'''Rrabel Dage''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalist]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] and just prior to the [[Battle of Duro]], he protested allowing refugees to relocate to Duro and planned to use his contacts with the [[Bburru Docking Authority]] to sabotage emergency supplies being transported by [[CorDuro Shipping]] to the refugee settlements. Unbeknownst to Dage, the supplies were secretly being diverted to [[Urrdorf City]] by [[Durgard Brarun]], a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] collaborator on the CorDuro Executive Committee.<ref name="University" />
